title: Ex Ōre Equī · Diēs Mārtis, a.d. VIII Kal. Dec. (Tue 24 Nov 2026)
summary: Canberra: 11–24°, partly cloudy, fog early, 40% chance of a shower (0–1 mm), UV 10. Wednesday 9–25°, cloudy, 10% chance of rain. Sydney 24 (showers), Melbourne 19, Brisbane 30, Perth 23, Adelaide 23, Hobart 17, Darwin 35 (storm). Australia: day two of the last sitting week; gas reservation bill still not passed; Jane Hume: not 'at any price', 'the ball is in the government's court'; COP31 ended without a deal after two weeks (longest COP on record); Bowen: 'I regret we didn't get it'; Tehan: 'how much more money does this minister need to waste before you sack him?'; Taylor: 'This Energy Minister should resign… He's not up to the job', 'We should scrap net zero'; Albanese on retiring: 'No.'; Newspoll preferred PM Taylor 42–41; October CPI Wednesday, consensus 4.8% (from 4.3%). Iran: no damage to US forces in Bahrain, Iran's 4th attempt in a week; Trump inclined to strike again after the new year if no deal, Iran's negotiators 'professional tap dancers'; 14+ Iranian tankers at Kharg, blockade day 130; Trump: 'they'll all be at the bottom of the sea like the rest of the navy'; Baghaei: 'every means to counter US aggression'; Araghchi: Hormuz could reopen 'within two hours'; Brent ~$90, 3-month low. US: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang (resigned 12 Nov; ~$1tn lost); Trump: 'I convinced them. I made the deal.', 'he's certainly a genius'; Huang: 'I can't wait to get back to work'; midday Nasdaq +6.9%, Dow +3.2%, Nvidia +32%; Kirsten Davies acting cyber director. Ukraine: Dymer toll 11, woman of 79 rescued; 153 drones / 134 down; NATO council in Brussels on the missiles in Poland (debris at three sites; Gripen pilot held fire in bad weather; extra allied aircraft); Rutte: 'I will never speculate'; Peskov: talks soon, 'considering Abu Dhabi'; swap still pending. Good news: North Stradbroke Island koala hospital, joey recovering (ABC). Opīniō: Michael de Percy, 'Your standard of living is in freefall' (Spectator Australia). Theodosius I enters Constantinople, 24 Nov 380. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; WillyWeather; ABC; Region; SBS; The Nightly; MNI; Iran International; Breitbart; Euronews; Times of Israel; Trading Economics; Fox Business; ABC News; Yahoo Finance; Reuters; Ukrinform; Kyiv Independent; Censor.net; Liga.net; Kyiv Post; RBC-Ukraine; The Spectator Australia; Socrates Scholasticus; De Imperatoribus Romanis.
lines: spl
Hello, listeners. This is Straight from the Horse's Mouth.
Salvēte, audītōrēs. Haec sunt nūntia ex ōre equī.
pl
Today is Tuesday, the eighth day before the Kalends of December.
Hodiē est diēs Mārtis, ante diem octāvum Kalendās Decembrēs.
pl
In the year 2026.
Annō bis mīllēsimō vīcēsimō sextō.
pl
Yesterday we said: neither war nor peace. In the stable we call that Tuesday.
Herī dīximus: neque bellum neque pāx. In stabulō id diem Mārtis vocāmus.
pl
Today is Tuesday. We have checked. Still neither war nor peace. The stable was right.
Hodiē est diēs Mārtis. Īnspeximus. Adhūc neque bellum neque pāx. Stabulum rēctē dīxit.
pl
First, the weather. Then Australian affairs.
Prīmum tempestās. Deinde rēs Austrāliae.
pl
Then the world: Iran, America, Ukraine.
Deinde orbis terrārum: Īrānia, America, Ūcraīna.
pl
Then a happy story, opinion, and today in history.
Tum rēs laeta, opīniō, et hodiē in historiā.
pl
At the end, the words of the day.
In fīne, verba diēī.
en
The weather. Canberra: 11 to 24 degrees, partly cloudy, fog early, a 40% chance of a shower, at most 1 mm. UV very high. Tomorrow 9 to 25, cloudy, only a 10% chance of rain.
spl
The weather.
Tempestās.
pl
First, Canberra.
Prīmum Canberra.
pl
Today in Canberra the sky is partly cloudy.
Hodiē Canberrae caelum partim nūbilum est.
pl
In the morning 11 degrees, with fog.
Māne ūndecim gradūs, cum nebulā.
pl
In the afternoon 24 degrees.
Post merīdiem vīgintī quattuor gradūs.
pl
A shower is possible: 40 per cent. But at most one millimetre.
Imber possibilis est: quadrāgintā per centum. Sed ūnum mīllimetrum ad summum.
pl
Tomorrow, Wednesday, the sky will be cloudy, but rain is unlikely: 10 per cent.
Crās, diē Mercuriī, caelum nūbilum erit, sed pluvia vix ventūra: decem per centum.
pl
Tomorrow morning 9 degrees, in the afternoon 25.
Crās māne novem gradūs, post merīdiem vīgintī quīnque.
pl
Yesterday rain, today sun. The grass is excellent. The flies are already up.
Herī pluvia, hodiē sōl. Herba optima est. Muscae iam surrēxērunt.
pl
Now the other cities.
Nunc cēterae urbēs.
pl
In Sydney showers, and early in the morning perhaps thunder. 24 degrees.
Sydnēiae imbrēs, et prīmā lūce fortasse tonitrus. Vīgintī quattuor gradūs.
pl
In Melbourne partly cloudy. 19 degrees.
Melburnī caelum partim nūbilum. Ūndēvīgintī gradūs.
pl
In Brisbane partly cloudy. 30 degrees.
Brisbanae caelum partim nūbilum. Trīgintā gradūs.
pl
In Perth partly cloudy, perhaps a shower. 23 degrees.
Perthī caelum partim nūbilum, fortasse imber. Vīgintī trēs gradūs.
pl
In Adelaide mostly clear. 23 degrees.
Adēlāidae caelum plērumque serēnum. Vīgintī trēs gradūs.
pl
In Hobart partly cloudy, perhaps a shower. 17 degrees.
Hobartī caelum partim nūbilum, fortasse imber. Septendecim gradūs.
pl
In Darwin showers, and in the afternoon thunder. 35 degrees.
Darwīnī imbrēs, et post merīdiem tonitrus. Trīgintā quīnque gradūs.
pl
That is the weather.
Haec est tempestās.
en

Australia. Day two of the last sitting week. The gas reserve law has still not passed. Jane Hume: the Coalition wants the scheme, but not 'at any price'; 'the ball is in the government's court.' COP31 in Turkey ended with no deal after two weeks, the longest ever. Bowen: 'I regret we didn't get it.' Dan Tehan in Question Time: 'how much more money does this minister need to waste before you sack him?' Taylor: 'This Energy Minister should resign… He's not up to the job.' Asked if he had thought of retiring, Albanese said: 'No.' Newspoll: Taylor 42, Albanese 41 as preferred PM. Tomorrow the October prices: economists expect 4.8%, up from 4.3%.
spl
Australian affairs.
Rēs Austrāliae.
pl
Yesterday we said: today begins the last week of parliament this year. The law about the gas has still not been passed.
Herī dīximus: hodiē incipit ultima hebdomas comitiōrum huius annī. Lēx dē gas adhūc nōn lāta est.
pl
One day has passed. The law about the gas has still not been passed. Three days are left.
Ūnus diēs praeteriit. Lēx dē gas adhūc nōn lāta est. Trēs diēs restant.
pl
Jane Hume says: the Coalition wants the plan, but not at any price.
Jane Hume dīcit: Coalitiō cōnsilium vult, sed nōn quōvīs pretiō.
pl
And she says: the ball is in the government's court.
Et dīcit: pila in campō reī pūblicae est.
pl
Not at any price. In the stable we never say that about hay.
Nōn quōvīs pretiō. In stabulō hoc dē faenō numquam dīcimus.
pl
Earlier we said: Bowen is at the great conference on the climate.
Anteā dīximus: Bowen in magnō conventū dē climate est.
pl
Now the conference has ended without a deal. After two weeks: the longest ever.
Nunc conventus sine pactiōne fīnītus est. Post duās hebdomadēs: longissimus umquam.
pl
Two weeks of talking, and no deal. A horse would have finished the race in two minutes.
Duae hebdomadēs sermōnum, et nūlla pactiō. Equus curriculum duōbus minūtīs cōnfēcisset.
pl
Chris Bowen, the energy minister, says: I regret we didn't get it.
Chris Bowen, minister ēnergiae, dīcit: doleō quod id nōn obtinuimus.
pl
In Question Time Dan Tehan asked: how much more money does this minister need to waste before you sack him?
In tempore quaestiōnum Dan Tehan rogāvit: quantum adhūc pecūniae hic minister perdere dēbet, antequam eum dīmittis?
pl
Angus Taylor, leader of the opposition, says: this energy minister should resign. He's not up to the job.
Angus Taylor, dux oppositiōnis, dīcit: hic minister ēnergiae abīre dēbet. Huic operī pār nōn est.
pl
And Albanese was asked: have you thought about retiring? His answer: No.
Et Albanese rogātus est: cōgitāvistīne dē sēcessū? Respōnsum eius: Nōn.
pl
One word. The shortest answer of the week. Retiring? No.
Ūnum verbum. Brevissimum respōnsum huius hebdomadis. Sēcessus? Nōn.
pl
In the poll the citizens prefer Taylor as prime minister: 42 to 41.
In percontātiōne cīvēs Taylor prīmum ministrum mālunt: quadrāgintā duo contrā quadrāgintā ūnum.
pl
42 to 41. At the racecourse we call that winning by a nose.
Quadrāgintā duo contrā quadrāgintā ūnum. In curriculō id 'nāsō vincere' vocāmus.
pl
And tomorrow, the new prices. Economists say: inflation will be 4.8 per cent.
Et crās pretia nova. Oeconomī dīcunt: īnflātiō erit quattuor per centum et octōgintā centēsimae.
pl
In September it was 4.3 per cent.
Mēnse Septembrī erat quattuor per centum et trīgintā centēsimae.
en

Iran. A US official: no damage to US forces in Bahrain; it was Iran's fourth attempted attack in about a week. Trump on Fox: if there is no deal, he is inclined to strike again after the new year; talks go on indirectly. He calls Iran's negotiators 'professional tap dancers'. More than 14 Iranian tankers wait at Kharg Island, perhaps to run the blockade, now in its 130th day. Trump: 'they'll all be at the bottom of the sea like the rest of the navy.' Baghaei: 'we will use every means to counter US aggression.' Araghchi: Hormuz could reopen 'within two hours' once the US meets its commitments. Brent about $90.
spl
The world. First, Iran.
Orbis terrārum. Prīmum Īrānia.
pl
Yesterday we said: an Iranian strike hit an industrial site in Bahrain. Trump said: I'm going to make a deal that is going to be permanent.
Herī dīximus: ictus Īrāniānus officīnam in Bahrainiā percussit. Trump dīxit: pactiōnem faciam quae perpetua erit.
pl
Now an American official says: no damage to the American forces. It was Iran's fourth attempt in about a week.
Nunc magistrātus Americānus dīcit: nūllum damnum cōpiīs Americānīs. Quartus cōnātus Īrāniae circiter ūnā hebdomade erat.
pl
On Fox Trump says: if there is no deal, perhaps new strikes after the new year. The talks go on, but not face to face.
In Fox Trump dīcit: sī pactiō nūlla erit, fortasse novī ictūs post annum novum. Sermōnēs pergunt, sed nōn cōram.
pl
He calls the Iranian negotiators professional tap dancers.
Lēgātōs Īrāniānōs 'saltātōrēs perītōs' vocat.
pl
Tap dancers. Horses have done that for centuries, in iron shoes, and never asked for a deal.
Saltātōrēs. Equī id per saecula faciunt, in soleīs ferreīs, nec umquam pactiōnem petīvērunt.
pl
More than fourteen Iranian oil ships are waiting at the island of Kharg. Perhaps they want to break the American blockade.
Plūs quam quattuordecim nāvēs oleāriae Īrāniānae ad īnsulam Kharg exspectant. Fortasse obsidiōnem Americānam rumpere volunt.
pl
The blockade has already lasted 130 days.
Obsidiō iam centum trīgintā diēs dūrat.
pl
Trump says about these ships: they'll all be at the bottom of the sea like the rest of the navy.
Trump dē hīs nāvibus dīcit: omnēs in fundō maris erunt, ut cētera classis.
pl
In Tehran, the spokesman Baghaei says: we will use every means to counter American aggression.
Tehrānī, ōrātor Baghaei dīcit: omnī modō iniūriae Americānae resistēmus.
pl
The foreign minister, Araghchi, says: the strait of Hormuz can open within two hours, when America keeps its promises.
Minister rērum externārum, Araghchi, dīcit: fretum Hormuziānum intrā duās hōrās aperīrī potest, ubi America prōmissa servābit.
pl
Two hours. The blockade: 130 days. The negotiators: still dancing.
Duae hōrae. Obsidiō: centum trīgintā diēs. Lēgātī: adhūc saltant.
pl
The price of oil: about 90 dollars a barrel.
Pretium oleī: circiter nōnāgintā dollarī prō dōliō.
en

America. On Monday Nvidia's board brought back Jensen Huang as chief executive; he had resigned on 12 November, and Nvidia lost about a trillion dollars in value. Trump: 'I convinced them. I made the deal.' 'We have to protect our geniuses, and he's certainly a genius.' Huang: 'I can't wait to get back to work.' Around midday the Nasdaq was up almost 7%, Nvidia more than 30%. The new cyber chief, for now: Kirsten Davies of the Pentagon.
spl
America.
America.
pl
Yesterday we said: one failure after another, the chief fired, and the market falls.
Herī dīximus: dēfectiō post dēfectiōnem, praefectus dīmissus, et bursa cadit.
pl
On Monday the market leapt up.
Diē Lūnae bursa subitō surrēxit.
pl
The reason: the company Nvidia brought back its chief, Jensen Huang.
Causa: societās Nvidia prīncipem suum, Jensen Huang, restituit.
pl
Huang had resigned on the twelfth of November. Then Nvidia lost about a trillion dollars in value.
Huang prīdiē Īdūs Novembrēs abierat. Deinde Nvidia circiter mīlle mīlliarda dollarōrum āmīsit.
pl
Trump says: I convinced them. I made the deal.
Trump dīcit: eīs persuāsī. Pactiōnem fēcī.
pl
And Trump says: we have to protect our geniuses, and he's certainly a genius.
Et Trump dīcit: hominēs ingeniōsōs nostrōs prōtegere dēbēmus, et ille certē ingeniōsus est.
pl
Huang says: I can't wait to get back to work.
Huang dīcit: cupidissimē ad opus redeō.
pl
The chief is back in the saddle. In the stable we say: never change horses in midstream. Nvidia changed, and changed back.
Prīnceps iterum in sellā est. In stabulō dīcimus: in mediō flūmine equōs nē mūtāveris. Nvidia mūtāvit, et rūrsus mūtāvit.
pl
Around midday the Nasdaq was up almost 7 per cent Nvidia: more than 30.
Circā merīdiem Nasdaq paene septem per centum surrēxerat. Nvidia: plūs quam trīgintā.
pl
And the cyber chief? For now Kirsten Davies, of the Pentagon, does the job.
Et praefectus cyberneticus? Interim Kirsten Davies, ē Pentagōnō, officium gerit.
en

Ukraine. In Dymer the death toll rose to 11; a woman of 79 was pulled alive from the ruins. On Sunday night 153 Russian drones, 134 brought down. NATO met in Brussels after Russian missiles fell in Poland. A Swedish Gripen pilot was allowed to shoot down a missile but did not fire: bad weather, he could not see the target. Poland asked for more air defence; allied aircraft came. Rutte, asked if it was on purpose: 'I will never speculate.' The Kremlin: talks 'in the near future'; 'We are currently considering Abu Dhabi.' The prisoner exchange has still not happened.
spl
Ukraine.
Ūcraīna.
pl
Yesterday we said: in Dymer a drone struck a block of flats. Three dead. Eleven are still missing.
Herī dīximus: in oppidō Dymer fūcus īnsulam percussit. Trēs mortuī. Ūndecim adhūc dēsīderantur.
pl
Now the governor says: the dead are eleven.
Nunc praefectus regiōnis dīcit: mortuī sunt ūndecim.
pl
But a woman of 79 was pulled alive from the ruins.
Sed fēmina ūndēoctōgintā annōrum ē ruīnīs vīva extrācta est.
pl
On Sunday night Russia sent 153 drones. Ukraine brought down 134.
Nocte Sōlis Russia centum quīnquāgintā trēs fūcōs mīsit. Ūcraīna centum trīgintā quattuor dēiēcit.
pl
Yesterday NATO met in Brussels, because Russian missiles fell in Poland.
Herī NATO Bruxellīs convēnit, quia missilia Russica in Polōniā cecidērunt.
pl
A Swedish pilot was allowed to shoot down a missile. But he did not fire: the weather was bad, he could not see it.
Gubernātōrī aëroplanī Suēcī licēbat missile dēicere. Sed tēlum nōn mīsit: tempestās mala erat, missile vidēre nōn poterat.
pl
Poland asked for more defence in the air. And the aircraft of the allies came.
Polōnia plūs praesidiī in āere petīvit. Et aëroplana sociōrum vēnērunt.
pl
Rutte was asked: was it on purpose? He says: I will never speculate.
Rutte rogātus est: cōnsultōne factum est? Dīcit: numquam coniectūram faciam.
pl
Never speculate. At the racecourse nobody keeps this rule. There everyone speculates, and loses money.
Numquam coniectūram. In curriculō nēmō hanc rēgulam servat. Ibi omnēs coniectūrās faciunt, et pecūniam āmittunt.
pl
And peace talks? Peskov, for the Kremlin, says: soon. We are currently considering Abu Dhabi.
Et sermōnēs dē pāce? Peskov, prō Kremlinō, dīcit: mox. Nunc dē urbe Abu Dhabi cōgitāmus.
pl
The exchange of prisoners has still not happened.
Permūtātiō captīvōrum adhūc nōn facta est.
en

A happy story. On North Stradbroke Island, near Brisbane, the island's vet, Jade Patterson, founded a charity that cares for wild animals on the island itself. Before, injured koalas went to the mainland and could never come back, because of disease. Patterson: 'a real game changer for us.' A young female koala was separated from her mother by two aggressive males; volunteers found her. Vet Thalita Calvi: 'She was extremely tired when she arrived.' Food and fluids, then sleep; two weeks later she is gaining weight and strength, and she will go back near her old home.
spl
A happy story.
Rēs laeta.
pl
On North Stradbroke Island, near Brisbane, the koalas are healthier than on the mainland.
In īnsulā Stradbroke Septentriōnālī, prope Brisbanam, koālae sāniōrēs sunt quam in continente.
pl
Before, injured koalas were sent to the mainland, and could never come back.
Anteā koālae vulnerātae in continentem mittēbantur, et numquam redīre poterant.
pl
Now wild animals are cared for on the island itself. Jade Patterson, a vet, founded a charity.
Nunc ferae in ipsā īnsulā cūrantur. Jade Patterson, medica animālium, societātem condidit.
pl
Patterson says: keeping those koalas on the island is a real game changer.
Patterson dīcit: koālās in īnsulā retinēre rēs vērē nova est.
pl
Recently a young koala was separated from her mother. Two angry males were fighting.
Nūper koāla parva ā mātre sēparāta est. Duo masculī īrātī pugnābant.
pl
Volunteers found her and brought her to the vet. The vet says: she was extremely tired.
Voluntāriī eam invēnērunt et ad medicam tulērunt. Medica dīcit: valdē fessa erat.
pl
Food, water, then sleep. A plan that every stable approves.
Cibus, aqua, deinde somnus. Hoc cōnsilium omne stabulum probat.
pl
After two weeks she is heavier and stronger.
Post duās hebdomadēs gravior et fortior est.
pl
Soon she will go back to her own trees, on the island.
Mox ad arborēs suās redībit, in īnsulā.
en

Opinion. Michael de Percy, in The Spectator Australia: 'Your standard of living is in freefall.' Chalmers' 'kinder' economy is hurting everybody. The cash rate is 4.85% and inflation is too high. The government refuses 'to use Australia's abundant resources to bring energy prices down.' And 'Chris Bowen's push for COP31 to end reliance on fossil fuels has failed'.
spl
Opinion.
Opīniō.
pl
This is the opinion of Michael de Percy, in The Spectator Australia.
Haec est sententia Michael de Percy, in Spectātōre Austrāliae.
pl
His title: your standard of living is in freefall.
Titulus eius: condiciō vītae tuae praeceps cadit.
pl
De Percy says: the 'kinder' economy of the Treasurer, Chalmers, is hurting everybody.
De Percy dīcit: rēs oeconomica 'benignior' Chalmers, ministrī aerāriī, omnibus nocet.
pl
And he says: the interest rate is 4.85 per cent, and inflation is too high.
Et dīcit: faenus est quattuor per centum et octōgintā quīnque centēsimae, et īnflātiō nimis alta est.
pl
De Percy says: the government will not use Australia's abundant resources to bring energy prices down.
De Percy dīcit: rēs pūblica opēs Austrāliae abundantēs adhibēre nōn vult, ut pretia ēnergiae dēscendant.
pl
And he says: Bowen's push at the conference on the climate has failed.
Et dīcit: cōnātus Bowen in conventū dē climate frūstrā fuit.
pl
Dearer hay, higher interest. In the stable we call that a double misfortune.
Faenum cārius, faenus altius. In stabulō id 'duplex malum' vocāmus.
en

Today in history. On 24 November 380 the emperor Theodosius I entered Constantinople for the first time. Earlier that year, gravely ill at Thessalonica, he was baptised by bishop Acholius. His father, also Theodosius, had been a master of the horse. Two days after his entry he expelled the Arian bishop Demophilus: 'Since you reject peace and harmony, I order you to quit the churches.' Then he gave the churches of the city to Gregory of Nazianzus.
spl
Today in history.
Hodiē in historiā.
pl
On this day, in the year 380, the emperor Theodosius entered Constantinople for the first time.
Hōc diē, annō trecentēsimō octōgēsimō, imperātor Theodosius prīmum Cōnstantīnopolim intrāvit.
pl
Earlier that year, in Thessalonica, he was gravely ill.
Anteā eōdem annō, Thessalonīcae graviter aegrōtābat.
pl
In his illness he was baptised by the bishop Acholius.
In morbō ab episcopō Acholiō baptīzātus est.
pl
His father, also Theodosius, had been master of the horse.
Pater eius, et ipse Theodosius, magister equitum fuerat.
pl
Master of the horse. In the stable that is the highest title. Higher than emperor.
Magister equitum. In stabulō id summum nōmen est. Altius quam imperātor.
pl
Two days later he expelled the Arian bishop, Demophilus.
Post duōs diēs episcopum Arīānum, Dēmophilum, expulit.
pl
He said: since you reject peace and harmony, I order you to quit the churches.
Dīxit: quoniam pācem et concordiam respuis, tē ecclēsiās relinquere iubeō.
pl
Then he gave the churches of the city to Gregory of Nazianzus.
Deinde ecclēsiās urbis Gregōriō Nazianzēnō trādidit.
en
The summary.
spl
The summary.
Summa rērum.
pl
The law about the gas has still not been passed. Three days are left.
Lēx dē gas adhūc nōn lāta est. Trēs diēs restant.
pl
The conference on the climate has ended without a deal.
Conventus dē climate sine pactiōne fīnītus est.
pl
Albanese was asked about retiring. His answer: No.
Albanese dē sēcessū rogātus est. Respōnsum eius: Nōn.
pl
Trump calls the Iranian negotiators tap dancers. The blockade has lasted 130 days.
Trump lēgātōs Īrāniānōs saltātōrēs vocat. Obsidiō centum trīgintā diēs dūrat.
pl
Nvidia brought back its chief, and the market leapt up.
Nvidia prīncipem suum restituit, et bursa surrēxit.
pl
In Dymer the dead are eleven. A woman was pulled alive from the ruins.
In oppidō Dymer mortuī sunt ūndecim. Fēmina ē ruīnīs vīva extrācta est.
pl
On Stradbroke Island a young koala is stronger, and will go back to her trees.
In īnsulā Stradbroke koāla parva fortior est, et ad arborēs suās redībit.
pl
On this day in 380 Theodosius entered Constantinople.
Hōc diē, annō trecentēsimō octōgēsimō, Theodosius Cōnstantīnopolim intrāvit.
en
The words of the day. Five sentences, slowly.
spl
The words of the day.
Verba diēī.
pl
Not at any price.
Nōn quōvīs pretiō.
pl
Retiring? No.
Sēcessus? Nōn.
pl
The negotiators are still dancing.
Lēgātī adhūc saltant.
pl
Nvidia brought back its chief.
Nvidia prīncipem suum restituit.
pl
I will never speculate.
Numquam coniectūram faciam.
pl
Again.
Iterum.
pl
Not at any price.
Nōn quōvīs pretiō.
pl
Retiring? No.
Sēcessus? Nōn.
pl
The negotiators are still dancing.
Lēgātī adhūc saltant.
pl
Nvidia brought back its chief.
Nvidia prīncipem suum restituit.
pl
I will never speculate.
Numquam coniectūram faciam.
pl
That was the news, straight from the horse's mouth. Goodbye, listeners. Again tomorrow.
Haec fuērunt nūntia ex ōre equī. Valēte, audītōrēs. Crās iterum.
p1pl
Now everything again, in Latin only.
Nunc omnia iterum, Latīnē tantum.
